prompt: Where is the company cafeteria located?
audioText: Where is the company cafeteria located? (A) On the lower ground floor. (B) At twelve thirty. (C) Yes, I had soup.
transcript: Where is the company cafeteria located? (A) On the lower ground floor. (B) At twelve thirty. (C) Yes, I had soup.
explanation: Câu hỏi 'Where' hỏi về vị trí nơi chốn, đáp án A 'On the lower ground floor' chỉ địa điểm.
translation: Căng-tin công ty nằm ở đâu?

prompt: When will the sales seminar begin?
audioText: When will the sales seminar begin? (A) In room 402. (B) Right after the keynote speech. (C) About thirty people.
transcript: When will the sales seminar begin? (A) In room 402. (B) Right after the keynote speech. (C) About thirty people.
explanation: Câu hỏi 'When' hỏi về thời gian, đáp án B 'Right after the keynote speech' chỉ mốc thời điểm bắt đầu.
translation: Hội thảo bán hàng khi nào bắt đầu?

prompt: Who approved this travel reimbursement request?
audioText: Who approved this travel reimbursement request? (A) Mr. Tanaka signed it this morning. (B) Flights to Chicago were affordable. (C) In the accounting folder.
transcript: Who approved this travel reimbursement request? (A) Mr. Tanaka signed it this morning. (B) Flights to Chicago were affordable. (C) In the accounting folder.
choices: Mr. Tanaka signed it this morning.
explanation: Câu hỏi 'Who' hỏi về người phê duyệt, đáp án A nhắc đến người thực hiện là Mr. Tanaka.
translation: Ai đã duyệt yêu cầu hoàn tiền công tác này?

prompt: Why hasn't the quarterly budget report been printed yet?
audioText: Why hasn't the quarterly budget report been printed yet? (A) The network printer is out of toner. (B) Fifty full-color copies. (C) Next Tuesday afternoon.
transcript: Why hasn't the quarterly budget report been printed yet? (A) The network printer is out of toner. (B) Fifty full-color copies. (C) Next Tuesday afternoon.
choices: The network printer is out of toner.
explanation: Câu hỏi 'Why' hỏi lý do, đáp án A giải thích nguyên nhân là máy in hết mực.
translation: Tại sao báo cáo ngân sách quý vẫn chưa được in?

prompt: Could you help me set up the audiovisual projector in Room 3B?
audioText: Could you help me set up the audiovisual projector in Room 3B? (A) Sure, as soon as I finish this phone call. (B) The projector was manufactured in Germany. (C) No, it wasn't very heavy.
transcript: Could you help me set up the audiovisual projector in Room 3B? (A) Sure, as soon as I finish this phone call. (B) The projector was manufactured in Germany. (C) No, it wasn't very heavy.
choices: Sure, as soon as I finish this phone call.
The projector was manufactured in Germany.
explanation: Lời yêu cầu giúp đỡ 'Could you help me...', phản hồi đồng ý 'Sure, as soon as I finish...' là câu trả lời trực tiếp và phù hợp nhất.
translation: Bạn có thể giúp tôi lắp máy chiếu ở phòng 3B không?

prompt: What is the woman concerned about?
explanation: Người phụ nữ lo lắng về việc lô bàn ghế bị hoãn giao hàng (delivery delay).
translation: Người phụ nữ lo lắng về điều gì?
audioText: W: Mark, the supplier just notified us that the custom desks won't arrive until next Wednesday because of shipping delays. M: Oh no, the new engineering hires arrive this Monday! Where will they sit? W: We can borrow temporary tables from Conference Room C until the desks are delivered.
